content: Customer Ishaan Bose called to follow up on his health policy renewal with DCoders, noting he hadn't received updates. Agent Karan Joshi confirmed the policy showed as expired due to a known auto-renewal glitch. Karan assured Ishaan he would send a new link for the renewal form to resolve the issue. The call concluded with the customer acknowledging the solution.

action_items: Send new renewal form link to customer
